import pytest
from datetime import date
from calendar_app import add_months

def test_add_months_zero_offset():
    assert add_months(date(2026, 4, 1), 0) == date(2026, 4, 1)

def test_add_months_positive_preserve_day():
    assert add_months(date(2026, 1, 15), 1) == date(2026, 2, 15)
    assert add_months(date(2026, 1, 15), 2) == date(2026, 3, 15)

def test_add_months_positive_clamp_end():
    # January 31 -> February (non-leap)
    assert add_months(date(2026, 1, 31), 1) == date(2026, 2, 28)
    # January 31 + 2 months -> March 31 (day preserved)
    assert add_months(date(2026, 1, 31), 2) == date(2026, 3, 31)
    # March 31 + 1 month -> April 30 (clamp)
    assert add_months(date(2026, 3, 31), 1) == date(2026, 4, 30)

def test_add_months_negative_preserve_day():
    assert add_months(date(2026, 3, 15), -1) == date(2026, 2, 15)
    assert add_months(date(2026, 3, 15), -2) == date(2026, 1, 15)

def test_add_months_negative_clamp_end():
    # March 31 - 1 month -> February 28 (clamp)
    assert add_months(date(2026, 3, 31), -1) == date(2026, 2, 28)
    # January 31 - 1 month -> December 31 (preserve)
    assert add_months(date(2026, 1, 31), -1) == date(2025, 12, 31)

def test_add_months_leap_year():
    # Feb 29, 2024 (leap) + 1 month -> Mar 29 (preserve)
    assert add_months(date(2024, 2, 29), 1) == date(2024, 3, 29)
    # Feb 29, 2024 + 12 months -> Feb 28, 2025 (clamp)
    assert add_months(date(2024, 2, 29), 12) == date(2025, 2, 28)
    # Feb 28, 2025 - 1 month -> Jan 28, 2025 (preserve)
    assert add_months(date(2025, 2, 28), -1) == date(2025, 1, 28)
    # Mar 31, 2025 - 1 month -> Feb 28, 2025 (clamp)
    assert add_months(date(2025, 3, 31), -1) == date(2025, 2, 28)
